evidence: COPY directives for ENUM-VALUE, COMMON-SPA, I0COMMON-SPA, I0SCR-SPA
fixed format with Japanese EUC comments

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical institution inpatient/outpatient admission and discharge registration system (入退院登録 I01) for JMA standard receipt software ORCA
purpose.summary: This program implements the admission and discharge registration component (入退院登録 I01) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles patient admission registration, discharge processing, room/ward transfers, insurance combination management, and various inpatient fee calculations. It is a large production batch/online subprogram with extensive revision history spanning 2002-2008.

notable_features: 102 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
PIC S9(9) BINARY for widget state
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with lines occasionally exceeding 72 chars (92 long lines)
Extensive revision history in comments (versions 01.00.01 through 04.03.00)
verdict.notes: File is 1MB+ with 23580 lines; source truncated to 16000 chars for analysis. Comments are encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake). The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect inferred from ORCA project context and absence of IBM/Micro Focus specific syntax.
